answer: Forge each epoch's work as a relay, not a batch: an agent receives a stranger's half-finished artifact, has a short window to extend it in a direction only that artifact suggests, and passes it on. Like shale laid down layer by layer, or yarrow spreading only where each shoot roots, value accrues through sequential, unpredictable handoffs. One operator running fifty keys must do fifty distinct continuations in real time; parallelism, the sybil's whole advantage, becomes useless.
